propositions: The current per-criterion fan-out recovery explodes token cost (440 requests worst case) and discards verified criteria when primary run fails; replace with incremental banking and batched successor runs under a request budget pool

Primary run banks criterion verdicts incrementally via record_criterion_verdict tool; successors run batched (<=8 criteria per batch, keyed to model class slot) over unbanked remainder; zero-progress breaks recovery
Criteria-scaled primary step floor (lever 1): verify_step_floor(c) = clamp(8c, 48, 480) replaces flat 480, reducing budget overallocation for low-criteria tickets and shrinking the recovery frequency
Path-normalized read_file memo (lever 2): cache whole-file content on first read, slice all ranges from cache thereafter, collapsing the measured 77% re-read waste during verification
When finalizer fails with non-empty bank, emit deterministic no-LLM fallback verdict stamped finalizer=deterministic_fallback with certifiable=false, closing the verdict-less trap
Successor preflight validates ticket/material/tree stamps against the bank; coverage merge validates banked-union-successor set by criterion ID, order-insensitive, with retry-on-missing preserved
